messages:
ashley: Quick heads-up — PR #12188 (service/session-timeout) needs to land before the maintenance blackout tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Currently blocked by ci-integrations/integration-test::session-timeout flake.

rajesh: Ack. Which test is failing? I saw a transient 504 in the logs earlier.

ashley: The Jenkins job shows a timeout in the session cleanup step. Short excerpt:
```
ERROR: session cleanup timed out after 30s
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/srv/service/cleanup.py", line 78, in flush_sessions
    client.invalidate(session_id, timeout=30)
TimeoutError: request timed out
```
I tried a manual rerun but it's flaky.

miguel: I can take a look this afternoon. If we can't stabilize, can we merge behind the feature flag or gate it behind canary rollout so we avoid a rollback during the blackout?

ashley: There's an existing feature flag (ff/service-session-timeout). Preference is landing with tests green, but canary fallback is OK. @jordan can you give a quick review once CI is green?

ci-bot: build #12188.3 queued — running integration/session test suite on linux-x86-01.

olivia: FYI ops reminder — maintenance blackout window is 09:00-12:00 UTC tomorrow. No schema migrations or infra restarts during that window.

rajesh: I'll try a targeted rerun and pin a dependency that regressed timers. Command I used locally:
```
./scripts/ci/run-tests.sh --pattern integration/session --rerun-flaky --target=server
```
If that passes I'll push a minor patch.

ashley: Thanks — please ping here when green. If it's still flaky by 04:00 UTC I'll request a short pre-blackout merge window from release lead.

jordan: Will review asap once CI passes. :+1:

ci-bot: build #12188.3 succeeded — integration/session all green.

ashley: Green! @jordan this is ready for review and merge. Holding until you approve given the blackout.

jordan: Quick look done — left one tiny nit but non-blocking. Approving now.

ashley: Approved and merging (commit 9a7c2d3). Merging with ff/service-session-timeout enabled by default in canary. Monitoring for 30m. :shipit:

miguel: Noticing a small spike in token latency on canary nodes, digging into the KV cache warmup. Not blocking yet, will update.

ashley: Thanks — I'll keep an eye on dashboards and will escalate if error rate > 0.5% in 10m.

olivia: Noted. If you need a rollback window after blackout, let me know and we'll coordinate with infra.
